title: Workflow library
lead: Every ComfyUI workflow is registered as a local model and shows up in its step's local model list. Recommended and “My workflows” join presets, automatic routing and fallback; unverified ones can only be picked by hand.

tierWhy.recommended: Ships with the studio, node packs and models pinned and tested. Joins presets, automatic routing and fallback.
tierWhy.mine: Imported by you and passed a trial. Joins presets, automatic routing and fallback like the recommended ones.
tierWhy.unverified: No passed trial yet (or the file changed, or the check found problems): only picked by hand, never in presets, fallback or “Try another”.

bindings.dramastudio: Uses DramaStudio input / output nodes: the studio fills in and reads back by node type, no bindings needed.
bindings.lead: Nodes are found by title (not id), so reordering or adding other nodes in ComfyUI does not matter; a bound title must be unique in the workflow.
bindings.pendingNote: {{count}} bindings were guessed on import. Confirm them before a trial or registering.

check.okLine: Everything is there: node types, bound node titles and fields, model files.
check.installNote: You approve the list of changes first, and a ComfyUI-Manager snapshot is taken before anything installs; snapshots and rollback are under Environment.
check.snapshotNote: A ComfyUI-Manager snapshot is taken first. If something breaks, roll back with one click under Environment.
check.installed: Snapshot {{snapshot}} saved; installed {{packs}} node packs, {{models}} models

trial.lead: One run on the sample project's inputs: first frame, reference images, prompt, dialogue audio, at the draft size and shortest duration. Queued on the local GPU.
trial.prompt: A rainy street at night: Lin Xia turns back under a red umbrella, neon reflected in the puddles
trial.blockedCheck: Install the missing node packs and models first

importDialog.title: Import workflow
importDialog.lead: Imported workflows are checked right away; without DramaStudio nodes the studio guesses the bindings for you to confirm one by one.
importDialog.drop: Drop a ComfyUI API-format JSON here
importDialog.dropHint: In ComfyUI, use “Export (API)” to get one
importDialog.done: Imported “{{name}}”: confirm the bindings, then run a trial
importDialog.badFile: This file is not a ComfyUI API-format workflow

empty: No workflows in this tier yet.
